reports.title: Diodes Incorporated Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: Gary Yu further commented, “For the fourth quarter of 2026, we expect to extend our strong growth momentum with revenue expected to increase to approximately $550 million, plus or

minus 3%, representing a 40.4% increase year-over-year and a 3.2% increase sequentially at the mid-point. Non-GAAP gross margin is expected to expand to 37.0%, plus or minus 1%. Non-GAAP adjusted EPS is expected to be $1.35, plus or minus $0.10.”
